exposure: Feeding type (exclusively human milk, mixed human milk/formula, exclusively formula)
cohort: The study included 7516 preterm infants with a gestational age of less than 29 weeks.
finding: Prophylactic L. acidophilus/B. infantis probiotics were associated with improved growth in exclusively human milk-fed infants, and provided a protective effect against clinical sepsis only in mixed human milk and formula-fed infants.
